### What are they?

*Data principles guide the actions of managing and stewarding data to make data more reusable and well documented.*

### [FAIR Principles](https://doi.org/10.1038/sdata.2016.18)

The FAIR Principles are focused on digital resources and data, especially machine-actionability, and include the following: 

 - Findable
 - Accessible
 - Interoperable
 - Reusable

<br>

### [CARE Principles for Indigenous Data Governance](https://doi.org/10.5334/dsj-2020-042)

THe CARE Principles are focused on people and purpose, and include the following: 

 - Collective Benefit
 - Authority to control
 - Responsibility
 - Ethics
